body: This app replaces my very simple bullet journal that I’ve been using. I didn’t want anything too complicated to use and this fits the bill! I love the interface and stats. I’m not really utilizing the AI suggestions because I already know what I need to do and what I want to track.
author: renayr

title: DON’T waste you $
body: Bought the app today, luckily only paid $19. I went through the app and its the most useless app out there. You can track your stuff in notes or excel. Basically eat healthy, do productivity stuff, exercise, sleep. Dont waste your $ on this. Youtube is free and much better! “0” stars!
author: Imtiaz1974

title: Not impressed
body: I received my login and pdf.  Couldn’t open and app support was “not found” .  When I tried to open the app, it crashed and would leave the loading page. The pdf wasn’t found as well.
author: gieco1487

title: Meh
body:
Trying for a few days and nothing special. No integration with health and that’s pretty much a given for todays apps which track sleep, water, exercise, activity, etc. The sleep function doesn’t sync with the habit tracker, it’s attached to the app but you need to record the sleep and sleep habits separately, that’s just lazy or n their part.
No watch complication.
Watch the pay scheme pretty pricey for what it does but if you go online to get the app you get it for much cheaper .

But overall.  1 star.  Like I said Meh. Nothing special
author: SteveDee43

title: Usually good and 5 star but won’t save data now
body:
Won’t save the daily data, I use the ‘Most Important Task’ and gratitude or I should say, try to but the data never saves anymore, so when you go back to note whiter you’ve completed this or not the data isn’t there for you to review! Can’t find help anywhere, it just takes me to the website where I also can’t find a place to report the issue?

Please fix.
author: 😁DH😁

title: Just an upsell scheme
body: I bought a lifetime premium account but I don’t get everything. I have to pay an additional $57 or $84 u.s. or the full plan.   This seems to be the only reason for the app is to sell you an upgrade.  It should have been included in the premium account .

author: raptor235

title: Didn’t even make it pass the intro. What a joke
body:
Wouldn’t recommend anyone go on this app, alternatives all over the place . Didn’t even make it through the intro, because beyond the subscription, there are more and more charges. Tracking system cost you 50ish some thing , coaching cost more, and then habit building , etc. cancel the 7 trail period with in 3mins of launching the app. 
 If you guys actually put some effort into the app it self other than prompting charging page, it maybe better .
author: Nestor Fox

title: Excellent customer service
body: I am beyond impressed with this app and their customer service. Sent an email before going to sleep and the issue was solved before I woke up. I had a reply by the CEO himself who on top of solving my issue extended an upgrade as a courtesy gesture. Again, very impressed with their service and how they care for their customers.
author: Maziel@

title: Not working
body: There’s an initial walk through of the app that freezes up. Can’t be cleared out so app becomes useless. The walk through, before the freeze up, was very focused on getting the user to sign up for an expensive subscription. Maybe, but the app UI and performance are amateurish.
